name: io.github.commet/argus-decision-mcp
description: Decision-accountability MCP server — seal a falsifiable prediction, settle it against reality. The receipt carries AI VERDICT NONE: the model never grades you, reality does.

environmentVariables.name: ARGUS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for the append-only ledger (.argus). Set once and every tool falls back to it. Claude Code expands ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}; on other hosts use an absolute path.

environmentVariables.name: ARGUS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional Argus account token. Set it and sealed predictions sync so the Companion Brief can email you at the check-by date. Unset = fully local, no network.

environmentVariables.name: ARGUS_TZ
environmentVariables.description: Timezone that decides when a check-by date becomes today (e.g. Asia/Seoul). Unset = UTC.
